anomalies.observed: The switch connects NET0043 to GND; NET0043 is connected to U7.48. U7.45, the SKW92A HW_RESET pin, is not connected to the switch.
anomalies.expected: The switch should connect GND to HW_RESET on the SKW92A.

evidence.quote: S2 pin 1: NET0043; pin 2: GND; pin 3: no-connect (EthernetAndPower.kicad_sch, page 4)
NET0043 is connected to U7 pin 48; HW_RESET is U7 pin 45 (SkylabModule.kicad_sch, page 2)

anomalies.impact: Operating the switch pulls NET0043 low rather than asserting hardware reset, so the intended reset function will not work and a different module signal will be affected.

parsed.summary: The switch is wired between GND and NET0043, which the drawing connects to U7.48, rather than the specified HW_RESET pin U7.45. The reset switch therefore will not perform its intended function.
